description: This C# source file defines a generic class StorageDataSetPlain<TGrainKey> that implements IEnumerable<object[]>. It generates test data sets for storage testing, including methods to retrieve test data with random grain IDs and states, and uses internal classes and utilities related to Orleans grain types.

classes.name: StorageDataSetPlain
classes.description: A generic class providing test data sets for storage tests, with methods to generate and enumerate test data.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing a grain type string, a grain ID, and a grain state with test data, based on the input test number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the range of test cases, yielding object arrays with test case indices.
